candidate.expression: S = ∫d⁴x √(-g) [ (M_pl²/2) f(φ) R + P(φ,X) + Q(φ,X) Box(φ) + a1(φ,X) φ_{μν}φ^{μν} + a2(φ,X) (Box(φ))² ] + S_matter[ g~_{μν}, Ψ ],  where X ≡ g^{μν}∂_μφ∂_νφ, Box(φ) ≡ g^{μν}∇_μ∇_νφ, and the single universal matter metric is g~_{μν} = C(φ,X) g_{μν} + D(φ,X) ∂_μφ ∂_νφ. All matter fields Ψ (every species, uniformly) couple minimally only to g~_{μν}; C and D are universal functions of (φ,X) with no per-species or per-object parameters.

canonical.action: S = ∫d⁴x √(-g) [ (M_pl²/2) f(φ) R + P(φ,X) + Q(φ,X) Box(φ) + a1(φ,X) φ_{μν}φ^{μν} + a2(φ,X) (Box(φ))² ] + S_matter[ g~_{μν}, Ψ ],  where X ≡ g^{μν}∂_μφ∂_νφ, Box(φ) ≡ g^{μν}∇_μ∇_νφ, and the single universal matter metric is g~_{μν} = C(φ,X) g_{μν} + D(φ,X) ∂_μφ ∂_νφ. All matter fields Ψ (every species, uniformly) couple minimally only to g~_{μν}; C and D are universal functions of (φ,X) with no per-species or per-object parameters.
canonical.claimed_static_limit: In the weak-field, static, spherically symmetric limit with φ settling to a slowly varying background (X→X0 small), and with f→const≈1, C→1, D→0 at leading order, the action is expected to approach the Schwarzschild/PPN limit up to corrections set by C_φ, C_X, D evaluated at the background. The magnitude and sign of these corrections are not computed here and are not claimed to satisfy any Solar-System bound; that determination belongs to the vacuum/Newtonian-asymptotics and Solar-System-control gates, which have not been run on this candidate.
evasion_rationale: Not a gradient_state construct: X=g^{μν}∂_μφ∂_νφ enters only through the universal functions C(φ,X), D(φ,X) applied identically to the single matter metric shared by all species; it is not used to build a per-object or per-species state-dependent response coefficient.
Not a measured_state construct: g~_{μν} is defined purely covariantly from (g,φ,∂φ) inside the action; no operationally- or measurement-defined variable enters the Lagrangian.
Not a flux construct: the map from (g,φ,∂φ) to g~ is strictly local and pointwise; no surface integral, boundary flux, or non-local flux-through-a-region term is used anywhere.

Not a saturation construct: C and D are left as general functions with no inserted threshold, cutoff, or saturation scale tied to any specific object's properties, consistent with the no-object-specific-parameters requirement.

The higher-derivative terms a1, a2 are restricted by an explicit machine-readable algebraic relation (dc1) rather than a prose-only degeneracy claim, directly targeting the prior higher_derivative_degeneracy_declaration rejections.
canonical.expected_dof: Nominally 3: 2 tensor (graviton) polarizations plus 1 scalar (φ), contingent on dc1 and dc2 holding exactly to remove the Ostrogradski mode from the (φ_{μν}φ^{μν}, (Box φ)²) sector. The full Hamiltonian/constraint analysis including feedback from the disformally coupled matter sector has not been performed by this proposal; additional propagating modes cannot be excluded prior to that gate.
falsification_tests: Torsion-balance equivalence-principle test comparing free fall of differing material compositions in a common local field: any composition-dependent departure from the single universal g~_{μν} coupling falsifies the matter-metric structure of this action.

Sub-millimeter laboratory short-range force (Cavendish-type torsion pendulum) measurements bounding deviations from an inverse-square static potential, constraining D(phi,X) and the X-derivative of C at laboratory background X.

Direct time-of-flight light time-delay (Shapiro-type) measurement using directly tracked spacecraft transponders or planetary radar echoes, bounding the phi- and X-derivatives of C against the PPN gamma parameter using only time-of-flight data, with no cosmological distance indicator involved.

Direct co-located timing comparison of a tensor-wave signal against an electromagnetic timing signal over a known terrestrial or laboratory baseline, bounding any tensor-sector speed modification introduced by f(phi).
fields: matter fields Ψ (all Standard-Model sectors, coupled only through g~_{μν})
canonical.matter_metric: Single universal disformal metric g~_{μν} = C(φ,X) g_{μν} + D(φ,X) ∂_μφ ∂_νφ, applied identically to every matter species with no per-object or per-species parameters, satisfying the one-universal-matter-metric requirement. Invertibility of this map (needed for a well-defined matter sector) requires C ≠ 0 and C + X·(dD/dX)·X ≠ 0 pointwise; this has not been independently re-verified here and is flagged as an open item rather than an assumed pass.
canonical.proposal_type: degenerate higher-order scalar-tensor (DHOST-type) gravity with a single universal disformal matter metric
symmetries: local Lorentz invariance in metric formulation
no shift symmetry or other global symmetry imposed on φ
universal_constants: Planck mass M_pl (equivalently Newton's constant G)
speed of light c set to 1
